name: Collapse by Silvestre Pestana
description: Explore the work of a pioneer of Portuguese visual poetry and experimental art in this compelling solo exhibition.
longDescription:
"Collapse by Silvestre Pestana" is a solo exhibition at the Galeria Municipal do Porto, dedicated to the work of Silvestre Pestana, a significant figure in Portuguese visual poetry and experimental art. The exhibition presents a comprehensive overview of Pestana's artistic practice, showcasing his contributions to the avant-garde and his exploration of various media and conceptual approaches within the realm of visual arts.

Visitors to the exhibition can expect to encounter a range of works that reflect Pestana's innovative spirit and his engagement with the intersections of language and image. The Galeria Municipal do Porto provides a contemporary setting for the display, allowing for a focused appreciation of the artist's output. The exhibition is suitable for individuals interested in modern and contemporary Portuguese art, as well as those with an interest in experimental art forms.

Admission to "Collapse by Silvestre Pestana" is free. The exhibition runs from April 23 to June 28, 2026. The Galeria Municipal do Porto is located within walking distance from Carolina Michaelis metro station.
